generalCriterionList.description: TENDERS FROM JOINT VENTURES ARE NOT ACCEPTABLE
BIDDERS SHALL NOT BE UNDER A DECLARATION OF INELIGIBILITY FOR CORRUPT AND FRAUDULENT PRACTICES ISSUED BY ANY STATE GOVERNMENT / GOVERNMENT OF INDIA /UNION TERRITORY.

IT SHALL BE THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE BIDDER TO ENSURE CREDIT OF TENDER PROCESSING FEE AND EMD INTO THE RESPECTIVE RECEIVING BANK ACCOUNTS OF KPP PORTAL ON OR BEFORE THE LAST DATE AND TIME OF BID SUBMISSION.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

TO ENSURE BROWSER COMPATIBILITY OF THE COMPUTER WELL IN ADVANCE TO THE LAST DATE AND TIME FOR RECEIPT OF TENDERS THE DEPARTMENTS SHALL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR NON ACCESSIBILITY OF kPP PORTAL DUE TO INTERNET CONNECTIVITY ISSUES AND TECHNICAL GLITCHES AT BIDDERS END.
EMD PAYMENTS THROUGH E-PAYMENT MODE SHALL BE MADE AS ONE SINGLE TRANSACTION AND PAYMENTS MADE IN PART ARE LIABLE FOR REJECTION.
BIDDER SHALL PAY CONTRACT MANAGEMENT MODULE PROCESSING FEES OF 0.025% OF THE CONTACT VALUE (MIN RS.500/- & MAX RS.7500/-) SOON AFTER CONTRACT HAS BEEN ISSUED TO BIDDER.
FOR DETAILS REFER TENDER NOTIFICATION AND CONDITIONS IN THE BID DOCUMENTS.
ALL MATERIALS SHOULD BE IN GOOD QUALITY AS PER SPECIFICATION, QUALITY CERTIFICATE FOR THE SAME SHOULD BE OBTAINED FROM THE CONCERNED AUTHORITY AT THEIR OWN COST.
ACCEPTENCE / CANCELLATION OF THE WORKS ARE RESERVED BY UNDER SIGNED WITHOUT ANY REASONS FOR THE SAME.
CORRIGENDUMS / MODIFICATIONS / CORRECTION, IF ANY, WILL BE PUBLISHED IN THE WEBSITE ONLY.

ALL THE SCANNED DOCUMENTS PERTAINING TO BIDDER TO BE UPLOADED SHALL BE IN ORIGINAL AND SAME ORIGINALS SHOULD BE PRODUCED TO THE EXECUTIVE ENGINEER (AT THE TIME OF TECHNICAL BID OPENING) WHO RESERVES RIGHT TO VERIFY THE ORGINAL DOCUMENTS BEFORE APPROVAL.
TO QUALIFY FOR AWARD OF THIS CONTRACT EACH TENDERER SHOULD GIVE ALL DETAILS AND DOCUMENTS AS PER TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL BID ATTACHED TO THIS TENDER.

ALL THE MATERIALS TO BE UTILISED FOR THE WORK MUST BE TESTED IN PRED LABS AND QUALITY CONTROL TEST REPORTS MUST BE ENCLOSED TO THE BILLS. ALL TYPE OF PIPES AND PUMPING MACHINARY WITH ACCESSORIES MUST BE TESTED IN M/S. SGS INDIA LTD, CIPET & AIPS INSTITUTES. COST OF ALL QC TEST MUST BE BORNE BY CONTRACTOR.
IF ANY DATE IN THE TENDER TIME TABLE IS GOVERNMENT HOLIDAY, NEXT WORKING DATE WILL BE CONSIDERED
INCOMPLETE / CONDITIONAL TENDERS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.
TENDERER MUST SUBMIT HIS PRESENT ACCURATE POSTAL ADDRESS AND PHONE / CELL PHONE NUMBER
THE TENDER MAY BE CANCELLED AT ANY STAGE WITHOUT ASSIGNING ANY REASON
TENDERERS MUST HAVE VALID PWD REGISTRATION COPY

THE RATES OF ITEMS ARE INCLUSIVE OF COST OF MATERIALS, LABOUR CHARGES, HOM OF MACHINERY, ALL LEAD AND LIFTS AND ALL OTHER CHARGES TO COMPLETE THE WORK SUCCESSFULLY AS PER SPECIFICATIONS AND AS DIRECTED BY ENGINEER IN CHARGE OF WORK
THE TENDERERS MUST SUBMIT THE SCANNED DOCUMENTS IN PDF / JPEG FORM, NOT IN OTHER FORM.
ANY OBJECTION REGARDING THE TENDER MUST BE SUBMITTED DIRECTLY TO EXECUTIVE ENGINEER , NOT IN INWARD.
WATER SUPPLY WORK DONE CERTIFICATE - MINIMUM 50% OF AMOUNT PUT TO TENDER (i.e. 5.69 LAKHS) ISSUED BY EXECUTIVE ENGINEER OR EQUIVALENT LAST 5 YEARS (2021-22 to 2025-26)

THE WORK IS SUBJECTED TO THIRD PARTY INSPECTION AND INSPECTION BY OTHER GOVT AGENCIES. THIRD PARTY INSPECTION COST IS BORNE BY THE CONTRACTOR AT THE RATE OF 0.5% OF THE GROSS AMOUNT OF THE BILL. THIRD PARTY AGENCY IS APPOINTED BY THE DEPT (EMPANELLED BY CHIEF ENGINEER RWD&S BANGALORE)
FOR INTERPRETATIONS OF CLAUSES, CONDITIONS, SPELLING MISTAKES, ETC., DECISION OF EXECUTIVE ENGINEER, RDW&S, KARWAR IS FINAL.

THE BIDDER MUST SUBMIT LAST 5 YEARS (2021-22 to 2025-26) PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT OBTAINED FROM CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT (CA) ONLY. BIDDER MUST HAVE ANNUAL CONTRACT AVERAGE TURN OVER FOR 2 YEARS NOT LESS THAN THE AMOUNT PUT TO TENDER (i.e. 11.38 LAKHS) IN EACH FINANCIAL YEARS. THE BIDDER MUST HAVE MINIMUM ASSESSED AVAILABLE TENDER CAPACITY AMOUNT PUT TO TENDER AS PER FORMULA IN KW DOCUMENT PROVIDED HERE WITH.
UNCONDITIONAL LIQUID ASSETS/BANK LINE OF CREDIT FROM ANY NATIONALIZED/SCHEDULED BANK MUST BE SUBMITTED AS PER KW BID DOCUMENT 30% of AMOUNT PUT TO TENDER i.e. 3.50 LAKHS.
GST SHALL PAID SEPERATELY
ALL OTHER CONDITIONS AS PER KW TENDER DOCUMENT
